AMC estimated that the change of test procedure (i.e., increased road load horsepower approximately 30 percent higher than that specified in the 1977 test procedure), coupled with the tighter emission standards, will cause a fuel economy loss exceeding ten percent. AMC said that it is essential that any 1979 or subsequent fuel economy standard recognize fully the impact of changes in both Federal and California emissions standards and test procedures.
